name: exp01_keyword_detection
description: Detect question words (who/what/where/when/how) via token embeddings and classify based on keyword patterns.

name: exp02_baseline_fixed
description: Baseline: identity transformer with fixed output prediction (always predict category 1).

name: exp03_question_word_signals
description: Encode question word signals (who/what/where/when/how) in token embeddings, use attention to aggregate, classify via output head.

name: exp04_focused_attention
description: Focus attention on positions 0-5 (question words) using position-based attention, detect 3rd char via MLP, classify.

name: exp05_strong_signals
description: Very strong question word signals in token embeddings, uniform attention, amplified through MLP layers.

name: exp06_position_attention
description: Strong position-based attention from pos 81 to pos 0, question word signals in first token.

name: exp07_first_3_chars
description: Encode first 3 characters with strong category signals, use averaging attention, amplify through MLP.

name: exp08_focused_attention_v2
description: Extremely focused attention from pos 81 to pos 0-2, very strong category signals in first 3 chars.

name: exp09_ultra_focused
description: Ultra-focused attention from pos 81 to pos 0 only, massive category signals in first char.

name: exp10_multihead_position
description: Multi-head attention: each head attends to different position (0-3), combine signals in MLP.

name: exp11_negative_suppression
description: Use negative position embeddings to suppress attention to positions 4+, focus on 0-3 only.

name: exp12_multi_char_detection
description: Detect first 5 characters with multi-head attention, each head attends to different position (0-4).

name: exp14_separate_dims
description: Separate position (dim 8) and category (dims 0-5) signals to avoid LayerNorm interference.

name: exp15_ultra_strong_focused
description: Ultra-strong category signals (100-250), position 81 attends ONLY to 0-2 with dim 6 control.

name: exp16_routing_signals
description: Use routing signals: position 81 queries 0-2, strong category signals (150-400) in dims 0-5.

name: exp17_pos0_to_4_strong
description: Positions 0-4 with very strong signals (200-500), position 81 attends to 0-4.

name: exp19_clean_routing
description: Clean dim allocation: chars in 0-31, categories in 32-37, routing in dim 60. MLP as AND-gate pattern detector.

name: exp20_ultra_strong_v2
description: Build on exp08: ultra-strong signals (300-600), position 1500, MLP amplification 15x, output 150.

name: exp21_single_layer_strong
description: 1-layer transformer, very strong signals (250-550), position 1000, MLP 12x, output 120.

name: exp22_two_layer_sharp
description: 2-layer transformer: layer 1 aggregates, layer 2 applies sharp decision with large bias (-3000).

name: exp23_negative_suppression_v2
description: Negative position embeddings (-800) suppress positions 3-80, positions 0-2 positive (800).

name: exp24_ultra_focused_attention
description: Ultra-focused attention with Q/K weights=5.0, position signals=600, strong category encoding.
